collector.differenceFromLimits02: Every mutating method is gated by the write-safety predicate, not PATCH alone, because this campaign sends its first writes over :batchWrite. The preflight prefix length is read from the plan. collector.py is byte-for-byte unchanged, so the frozen limits-02 collector source digest still resolves.
collector.scope: REST BatchWrite per-position outcome, create-only document writes, typed readbacks and request-stage name refusals, with ownership and version bound cleanup. No configuration, index, Rules or account operation.
collector.technicalBlocker: The limits production runner in tools/compat-broad/fs-write-limits/production.py is bound to the limits-02 compiler and does not yet accept this campaign. No frozen artifact, permission envelope or nonce reservation exists.

comparator.addition: A per-row structural field reports status, typed error code and status, the per-item BatchWrite codes and whether the document is present, with diagnostic wording removed. It is additive and never changes the classification. The duplicate-document control is expected to differ in wording, and this field keeps that from hiding the continuation answer.
comparator.contract: The limits-02 contract: both plans are regenerated from the compiler, every ordered request including its typed body is checked, a complete response journal is required, and normalized document identity and server timestamps may differ as EXPECTED_NONDETERMINISM while everything else, message text included, is significant.
